services.desc: Enjoy the waters of Casco Bay as you explore the four lighthouses sprinkled throughout the mouth of the harbor. Four different lighthouses constructed in four different classic achitectural styles. With Portland Head Light as the highlight, enjoy the unique experience of boating around the most photographed lighthouse in America! Portland and Casco Bay have a rich history dating back to when Native Americans who migrated to the shore in the summer. Later, not long after the Revolutionary War, the first forts and watch towers, still visible today, were built to guard the harbor.
